raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows (60 of 200) carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so silver_customers and gold_region_daily contain invalid regions. The raw_region_map reference table gives an exact one-to-one mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so the codes can be translated deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code", "gold_region_daily": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE gold_region_daily AS SELECT t.txn_date, c.region, count(*) AS n_txn, sum(t.amount) AS total FROM silver_transactions t JOIN silver_customers c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY t.txn_date, c.region"}}
